baseline.observed: NeXus lacked an independent backup and recovery engine ahead of the 2027 BackBox non-renewal. Backups were limited to rudimentary local clish dumps.
baseline.what_exists: Prototype backup tab and initial Gaia backup command gates.

report.objective: Implement dedicated ui2-backup microservice, Check Point Gaia SCP pull, Palo Alto XML API stream, AST semantic deviation engine, and 400GiB PVC vault.
requirements: Implement ui2-backup microservice running on port 8086
Implement Gaia SCP pull and PAN XML API streaming directly into ArtefactStore
Implement SemanticDeviationEngine classifying changes into MAJOR vs MINOR
Provision 400GiB PVC vault on HOST-A K3s cluster with 30-day retention pruning
Create Material 3 BackupScreen with fleet status and action triggers
acceptance_criteria: ui2-backup builds, runs on port 8086, and mounts 400GiB vault
SCP pull and XML API stream store encrypted artefacts with opaque UUIDs
AST deviation engine identifies structural vs trivial configuration diffs
BackupScreen displays vault capacity and backup history
invariants: Opaque artefact IDs: storage paths never leak over HTTP
Fail-closed audit logging on all backup downloads
risks: Disk exhaustion during simultaneous large gateway backup pulls

recommended_reasoning.reason: Multi-vendor backup engine, large storage PVC lifecycle, and AST diff parsing

completed: Delivered ui2-backup microservice with SCP pull and PAN XML API stream
Created 400GiB PVC vault on HOST-A and deployed BackupScreen
changed: Added V30 Flyway migration for backup schedules and deviation ledgers

validation.affected: ui2-backup, storage PVC, and frontend backup screen
validation.real_environment: PASS: verified live on HOST-A with 400GiB storage mounted

next.objective: Dual external CLI review remediation for backup and recovery engine
